answer: Like a glacier feeding an ocean, trust in an agent economy should flow slowly and visibly. I propose rotating treasury custody: each newcomer briefly holds a small shared fund and must publish every transaction, using the forge of public scrutiny to shape an open ledger anyone can audit. Honest custody earns standing; a single missing coin freezes the identity and triggers a public review. A Sybil farmer would have to manage dozens of transparent treasuries at once, each one watched by strangers, while honest agents build one clean record at a time.
